{{Infobox character |games =FOTV, FORPG |image =FOTV Season1 ep1 Biggie.jpg |race =[[Human]] |gender =Male |status =Deceased |dod =[[Timeline#2296|2296]] |dod verified=yes |family = |location = |affiliation = |TV actor =[[Joel Marsh Garland]] |stunt double = [[Danny Schoch]] |special ={{SPECIAL|6,5,6,5,4,5,5}} {{Icon|FORPG}} |tag skills =Athletics 2{{dot}} Big Guns 3 {{Icon|FORPG}} |level =2 {{Icon|FORPG}} }} '''Biggie''' is one of two lackeys of [[Honcho]] {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== Sometime in his life, Biggie met and affiliated himself with Honcho as one of his lackeys.{{fotv|1|1}} ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The End (episode)|The End]]=== Accompanying [[Slim (TV series)|Slim]] and his boss [[Honcho]] to awaken [[the Ghoul]], Biggie uses his [[Junk Jet (TV series)|Junk Jet]] to kill the [[Dom Pedro's guard|guard]] stationed there. Inside the compound, Biggie follows Honcho alongside Slim until they reach the area's graveyard. There, Honcho details to his two lackeys how [[Dom Pedro (character)|Dom Pedro]] digs up the Ghoul once a year to cut some pieces of him and then reburies him.[[Slim (TV series)|Slim]]: ''"How do we know which grave?"''
[[Honcho]]: ''"Well, Slim, we look for the fresh one. Dom Pedro has our friend dug up once a year. Cuts some pieces off and puts him right back in the ground."''
({{FOTV|1|1}}) Reaching [[the Ghoul's grave]], Biggie curses and claims that the person they're searching for is a [[Ghoul|mutant]]. Honcho snaps at the remark and explains that he's their ticket to a big payoff. After learning that the Ghoul had been buried underground for a long duration, he nervously asks how they don't know if the Ghoul has become [[Feral ghoul (TV series)|feral]]. However, Honcho then assures his lackeys that they'll be fine because he has a [[chicken]] on him. Biggie and Slim then dig up and pull the Ghoul's coffin out of the ground, readying their weapons as Honcho opens the coffin from a safe distance. Moments later, the Ghoul exits his coffin and, after gaining his composure, remarks that he's now a part of the Amish production of the Count of Monte Cristo, or it's the weirdest circle of jerks he's ever been invited to. After Honcho briefly chats with the Ghoul, they take a few steps back after the Ghoul takes an interest in the chicken and picks it up. While the Ghoul does this, Biggie asks if it's alright to shoot him because of this, and Honcho silences him. Honcho then tries to negotiate with the Ghoul, but when the negotiations break down, Honcho threatens to have Biggie and Slim put him back into his grave. The Ghoul then eyed both Biggie and Slim and told them that when people say that when it's the last job, it typically means their hearts are not in it. Then, he remarks that it probably never was, but finishes by confessing that he does it because he loves playing the game. When the Ghoul deals with Honcho, he uses Slim as a human shield when Biggie fires his Junk Jet at him. After the Ghoul tosses Slim aside, he blows off his head with Slim's [[Double-barrel shotgun (TV series)|double-barrel shotgun]]. ==Personality== Compared to his associate Slim, Biggie portrayed himself as having more nerve. ==Notable quotes== * {{Inline quote|Shit. You're telling me that the supreme badass we're looking for is a god-forsaken mutant?|Biggie talking about the Ghoul}} ==Notes== The names of Honcho and his gang are descriptive of themselves. [[Honcho]] is the head honcho of the gang, Biggie is very big, and [[Slim (TV series)|Slim]] is quite skinny. ==Appearances== Biggie appears only {{in|FOTV}}. His gameplay statistics appear in the ''[[Fallout 2d20: NPC Pack - Hollywood Heroes]]'' expansion pack for ''[[Fallout: The Roleplaying Game]]''. {{FOTV appearances|1=101}} ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[category:Fallout: The Roleplaying Game characters]]
